content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-works|How Digital]]-products-what-actually-how-8|payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-what-actually-how-2|COREMERCH guide to payments]] for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

Selling digital products as a creator is a global pursuit, with millions of entrepreneurs worldwide tapping into the digital economy. However, when countries or platforms impose restrictions, creators are forced to navigate an inflexible landscape that often prioritizes the interests of intermediaries over their own. The need for a sovereign commerce infrastructure that empowers creators to own and operate their own digital stores, unhindered by platform-driven restrictions, has become increasingly pressing. This is precisely the context in which COREMERCH emerges as a pioneering force, delivering a comprehensive solution that addresses the systemic limitations of traditional platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

COREMERCH's solution is built upon a robust stack of free and paid tools, carefully selected for their reliability, flexibility, and scalability. By leveraging the power of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Google Apps Script, creators can host their online stores, while Cloudflare Workers, Google Apps Script, and Supabase provide the necessary backend logic and order management capabilities. Meanwhile, NOWPayments ensures secure, automatic crypto payment processing, eliminating the need for intermediaries like Stripe. This architecture is not just a workaround but a permanent structural alternative that empowers creators to own their digital stores and manage their transactions directly.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH is specifically designed for digital creators from countries where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, or Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted. These creators, often in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or Zimbabwe, face significant barriers to online commerce due to platform-driven restrictions. By providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure, COREMERCH offers a lifeline to these entrepreneurs, enabling them to build and operate their own digital stores, unhindered by the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
Traditional platforms prioritize their interests over those of creators, leading to restrictive terms and conditions that hinder entrepreneurial ambitions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

At the heart of COREMERCH's solution lies a carefully curated set of components, each designed to work in harmony with the others. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provide the foundational infrastructure for creators to deploy their online stores, while the NOWPayments integration ensures seamless, secure payment processing. Additionally, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers comprehensive documentation, source code, and a scaling playbook, empowering creators to customize and optimize their digital stores as needed.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy COREMERCH's solution today, follow these concrete steps: Evaluate your business needs and choose the appropriate Stack (Sovereign Starter or Edge Commerce); Deploy your online store using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Google Apps Script; Configure NOWPayments for secure payment processing; Load your digital products and configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email delivery; Finally, monitor and refine your store's performance with the Complete Builder Kit's comprehensive documentation and scaling playbook.
